shortDescription: Child-feature delivery workflows and shared TDK runtime.
longDescription: TDK workflows for child feature specification, clarification, planning, implementation, analysis, status, and test-oriented development. The shared hook runtime remains in this plugin; project inception and workspace foundation workflows live in tdk-inception, and parent epic decomposition lives in tdk-epic.
defaultPrompt: Use TDK to specify and plan this child feature before coding.
Help me review or fix an implementation with the core workflow.
